subject: Core resolution and death/Wound source conflicts
authority: Canon manifest assigns combat to Core Systems Known Descent V2; gameplay v1.2 is retained in the review build and staged V7.2 evidence, not a silent override of approved combat. We author a clearly labelled active integration overlay rather than alter originals.

coreBookRelevantParagraphs.text: An attack roll is d20 + ability modifier + proficiency when proficient. A natural 1 misses. A natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice. Armor Class remains the primary defense, but cover, stance, shields, conditions, and reactions determine whether a target can survive concentrated attacks.
Replace one attack; Athletics or weapon check vs Athletics/Acrobatics. On success, held item falls in an adjacent space.
Bonus action Deception vs Insight. On success, gain advantage on the next melee attack this turn.
Reaction while Guarding; move 5 ft. and become the target of an attack against an adjacent ally.
Ready a ranged attack against movement through a named lane; the attack does not consume ammunition until triggered.
On a successful ranged hit, reduce target Speed by 10 ft. until it spends an action or succeeds on a Strength check.
After hitting in melee, move 5 ft. into the target’s vacated space if it retreats before your next turn.
Attack an object, shield, armor component, or construct joint. Damage applies to item durability rather than HP.
Replace one attack; Athletics vs Athletics/Acrobatics. On success, target falls Prone.
Action; move up to half Speed without provoking and gain +2 AC until movement ends.
Action; attach, lift, transfer, or protect up to one Extraction Load class of cargo.
A melee hit can force an immediate concentration check and prevents reactions with verbal components until target’s next turn.
Shove with disadvantage; on success push 10 ft. and remove Guard bonuses from adjacent allies.

Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Slashing, Thunder, and Corruption. Corruption damage cannot be resisted unless an effect explicitly protects against Corruption; it usually also creates a condition, mutation, or Unity Exposure.

Hit points represent endurance, luck, armor deflection, and minor injury. Wounds represent lasting trauma. A creature makes a Wound save when it drops to 0 HP, suffers damage equal to at least half its maximum HP from one source, or is struck by an effect marked Maiming. The save is Constitution, DC 10 or half the triggering damage, whichever is higher.
Gain one Wound. Each Wound imposes -1 on Constitution saves and maximum Hit Dice recovered per long rest.
Gain one Wound and roll on the Injury table.
Character is Critically Wounded: Speed -10 ft., cannot regain full HP, and dies on the next failed Wound save.
At 0 HP, a character is Unconscious and makes death saves at the start of each turn: 10+ success, 9- failure, three of either resolves the state.
A natural 20 restores 1 HP. A natural 1 causes two failures. Damage at 0 HP causes one failure, or two on a critical hit.
An action and DC 10 Medicine check stabilizes a dying creature. A healer’s kit succeeds automatically but consumes one use.
Resurrection restores life but does not automatically remove Wounds, Corruption, debt, legal death, or claims upon the recovered body.

An intelligent foe below one-quarter HP or with half its allies defeated makes a morale check unless Fanatical, Mindless, or controlled. Surrender can lead to ransom, recruitment, enslavement, interrogation, exchange, or release. These outcomes are economic and reputational decisions, not merely combat cleanup.

gameplayResolution:
Roll:

`d20 + ability modifier + proficiency, when trained + circumstance modifiers`

### Difficulty Classes

| Circumstance | DC |
|---|---:|
| Routine under pressure | 10 |
| Tier I standard | 12 |
| Tier II standard | 13 |
| Tier III standard | 15 |
| Tier IV standard | 16 |
| Tier V standard | 18 |
| Tier VI documented limit | 19 |

Use +3 DC for a hard version of the task and +6 DC for a severe version. Use -3 DC when preparation or superior tools make the task favorable.

### Degrees of outcome

- **Critical Success:** Total is at least DC + 10.
- **Success:** Total meets or exceeds the DC.
- **Failure:** Total is below the DC.
- **Critical Failure:** Total is at least 10 below the DC.

A natural 20 improves the result by one degree. A natural 1 worsens the result by one degree. It never improves beyond Critical Success or worsens beyond Critical Failure.

### Advantage and disadvantage

Roll two d20s and use the higher result for advantage or the lower result for disadvantage. Multiple sources do not stack. If both apply, they cancel.

### Assistance

A trained assistant who can meaningfully participate grants +1. Up to three assistants may contribute, for a maximum +3. An assistant exposed to the same danger suffers consequences on a Critical Failure.
gameplayDeathWounds:
At 0 HP, a character is Downed, Prone, and begins death saves at the end of each turn.

- 10 or higher: one success.
- 9 or lower: one failure.
- Natural 20: regain 1 HP.
- Natural 1: two failures.
- Three successes: Stable.
- Three failures: Dead.

Damage while Downed causes one failure, or two if the damage is a critical hit. Healing ends Downed.

### Wounds

Gain one Wound when any of the following occurs:

- Dropped to 0 HP by a critical hit.
- Suffered two death-save failures before stabilization.
- Revived after death or magical soul separation.
- Suffered a Severe hazard or injury result that specifies a Wound.

Each Wound imposes -1 Constitution saves and reduces Hit Dice healing by 1 per die, minimum 1. At three Wounds, the character is Critical: Speed is halved and Strain cannot be removed until at least one Wound is treated.

Treating a Wound requires a medical kit, one Supply, eight hours, and Medicine against the tier DC. Critical Success removes two Wounds; Success removes one; Failure consumes the Supply; Critical Failure also inflicts 1 Strain.
classAttackRules:
Use the class's own level, never total character level, for gates and effects. **L** means that class level; **S** is 1/2/3/4 at class levels 1/5/11/17. **M** means max(1, the class ability modifier), for effect a mounts only. Attacks use d20 + normal character proficiency + the actual appropriate ability modifier. Class save DC is 8 + normal proficiency + actual class ability modifier. Negative modifiers still apply to attacks and DCs. One tile is 5 ft. Fractions round down unless specified. Distances cannot be negative.

A weapon attack uses its usual ability, weapon die and damage type. A technique that says “make one weapon attack” replaces your Action with that attack; it does not also grant a normal Attack Action or Extra Attack. Generic attack-speed language has no effect beyond the exact attacks printed in the draft. A spell attack uses the class's stated casting ability. Natural 1 misses and natural 20 hits/critically doubles damage dice; flat bonuses do not double. A save succeeds at DC; “fails by 10” means the total is at least 10 below DC. Critical-range improvements never stack; use the broadest one.

An ability is known only if granted or selected by the draft schedule. Satisfy all printed prerequisites, target legality, action availability, recharge and resource costs before spending anything. A failed legal attack/save attempt still pays; an illegal activation spends nothing. No resource goes below 0 or above its cap. A class feature name shared with a spell does not grant both versions; use the version selected, with its own cost and timing. Names and source text are preserved; the current card is the operational draft.
currentSharedDamageRules:
Roll once for each shared area/pulse and apply saves/defenses to each target separately; separate attacks roll separately. Halve once for a successful save and apply resistance/immunity normally. Same-named conditions/bonuses do not stack unless a printed cap allows it; same-stat flat bonuses from these class techniques use the strongest. Different resources remain separate. Damage reduction from these class features uses the strongest flat reduction, then applies resistance; it cannot create negative damage or healing. Temporary HP never stack; choose the larger remaining amount. Immunity is not reduced resistance.

Repeated permanent HP recovery must consume finite RP, a per-rest use or another finite resource; a combat-generated gauge alone never enables unlimited healing. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP or erase Wounds, death consequences, debt or Corruption unless explicit. Downed is living at 0 HP; dead is different. Resurrection requires a willing soul and sufficiently intact body, obeys its time window, cannot create a duplicate and never refunds the feature on failure to meet known prerequisites. Sacrificial HP is actual unpreventable loss, cannot be redirected or paid with temporary HP, and is not damage for resource triggers. It cannot reduce the donor below 1 unless a card expressly grants a death-triggered effect.

No damage/healing copy repeats the source's costs, procs, resource generation, critical bonus dice, buffs, actions, cooldown resets or duration. Compute fractions once, capped at 100% of one stored source unless an explicit card states a separately priced higher amount. Copies still cause ordinary damage consequences, concentration checks and death. A copy cannot copy another copy. A target/source record must refer to an actual resolved event, not merely a known ability name.

Where a class card calls for a **standard companion** without a more specific profile, use: Small or Medium; AC 12+floor(PB/2); HP 2 L; walking Speed 30 ft; saves equal owner's PB; one melee or ranged attack (reach 5 ft/range 30 ft) at owner's class attack bonus, damage S d6 of the printed type. It has no independent class features, resources, loot, death triggers or extra turns. All companions belonging to one character share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging attack/action total per round** unless a specifically priced feature grants more. Without a command they move and Dodge. Act immediately after owner. A standard companion lasts 1 minute, disappears at 0 HP and cannot be healed for free by dismissing/resummoning. The creation cost must be paid again. Creature-specific stat blocks override this profile only where explicitly printed.
codexProposal: Attacks use Core AC hit test with nat1 always miss and nat20 always hit/critical doubling dice only. Beating AC by10 does not itself critically hit. Improved crit range uses an explicit reviewed feature and never stacks.

Task/skill/tool checks use gameplay four degrees with one natural shift, capped. If the particular action prints only success/failure, collapse critical success to success and critical failure to failure, adding no invented rider. Saves are binary total>=DC unless the specific effect prints margin outcomes; no automatic natural1/20 success/failure or generic crit save doubling. Death saves use their own explicit natural rules.

Tie on staticDC succeeds. Opposed tasks need a deterministic tie rule; preserve current state on tie unless a specific action says otherwise; task critical-success margin vs opposing total may be used only when an action actually prints a degree outcome. Do not mechanically double/halve opponent nat shifts.

Core death saves at START of regular turn; gameplay END timing is a rejected alternate for this candidate. Downed means Unconscious and Prone at0HP, not a second permissive combat state. Three successes stable, three failures dead, nat20=1HP, nat1=2failures, positive damage at0=1failure or2critical; actual healing>0 endsDowned. No extra-turn death-save farming.

Core Wound trigger/check/penalty/three-Wound state owns the candidate. Gameplay automatic Wound triggers/halfSpeed/HitDiehealing penalty are retained but inactive. Use gameplay kit+1Supply+8h tier-DC treatment as an explicit compatible recovery addition, not originalCorewording.

Need exact source-informed handling of simultaneous Wound/0HP/death-save events; oneWoundcheck perdamage event despite overlappingtriggers; oldWounds determineprecheckpenalty; no extraWoundjustbecause2deathsavesfailed unless expliciteffect. Core CriticallyWoundedcannotregainfullHP is underspecified and injurytable onfailure5 needs actualtablelookup; flag these rather than assert sourcednumbers.
request: Adversarially review allsix proposals against these exact sources. Give numbered accept/qualify/reject decisions and specific replacements. Identify unstated assumptions about save natural20/1, ties, damage->Wound->death event ordering and stable/dead states.
